versions.content: AUTOSAR shall support tracing of entries and exits of BSW modules. Description: AUTOSAR shall support recording and tracing of entry and exit events of BSW modules. Rationale: Provide a standardized way to trace timing events on BSW entries and exits to ensure tool compatibility. Dependencies: [SRS_Rte_00045] Use Case: Add a trace instrumentation to BSW module API functions. Supporting Material: -
